subject: 英语
description: 四年级下册英语核心知识点精华总结

cards.title: 天气表达
cards.definition: 用英语描述各种天气和温度。
core_points: 天气：sunny晴天 cloudy多云 rainy下雨 snowy下雪 windy有风 cold冷 warm暖 hot热 cool凉爽
What's the weather like (in Beijing)? 天气怎么样？— It's sunny and warm.
Can I go outside? 我能出去吗？— Yes, you can. / No, you can't.
It's 26 degrees. 26度。

mistakes.correct: 描述天气用形容词：It's rainy.（不是rain）
What's the weather LIKE? 别忘like

cards.memory_tip: 🌤️ 天气词大多加y变形容词：rain→rainy, snow→snowy, sun→sunny(双n), cloud→cloudy, wind→windy

cards.title: 时间表达
cards.definition: 认识时钟、学会用英语说时间。
core_points: What time is it? / What's the time? 几点了？
It's + 数字 + o'clock. 整点：It's seven o'clock. 7点整。
It's + 时 + 分：It's six thirty. 6:30。
Time for + 名词/to + 动词：Time for breakfast! / Time to get up!

mistakes.correct: o'clock只用于整点，七点半不加o'clock
Time FOR breakfast. 或 Time TO eat breakfast.

cards.memory_tip: ⏰ o'clock = of the clock 的缩写，只有整点才说「几点钟」

cards.title: 衣物词汇
cards.definition: 各种衣物的英语说法和试衣购物对话。
core_points: 上衣：shirt衬衫 T-shirt T恤 jacket夹克 coat外套 sweater毛衣 dress连衣裙 skirt裙子
下装：pants裤子 shorts短裤 jeans牛仔裤 socks袜子 shoes鞋
配件：hat帽子 scarf围巾 gloves手套 sunglasses太阳镜
Whose coat is this? 这是谁的外套？— It's mine/yours/his/hers.

example.question: Whose hat is this?
steps: It's my sister's. 是我姐姐的。

mistakes.correct: It's mine.（名词性物主代词）my后要跟名词: It's my hat.

cards.memory_tip: 👖 两条腿穿的都是复数: pants, shorts, jeans, socks, shoes — 因为都是成对的！

cards.title: 购物对话
cards.definition: 学习在商店买东西时的常用英语对话。
core_points: Can I help you? 有什么可以帮你的？— Yes, I want a shirt.
How much is it? 多少钱？— It's 50 yuan.
How much are they? 它们多少钱？— They're 80 yuan.
I'll take it/them. 我买了。/ It's too expensive. 太贵了。

example.question: 你想买一件T恤并问价钱
example.answer: Can I have a T-shirt, please? How much is it?

mistakes.correct: 复数用are: How much ARE they?

cards.memory_tip: 💰 How much = 多少钱，单个用is it，多个用are they

cards.title: 农场动物与蔬菜
cards.definition: 认识农场里的动物和常见蔬菜。
core_points: 农场动物：cow奶牛 horse马 sheep羊(单复数同) hen母鸡 lamb小羊 goat山羊
蔬菜：tomato番茄 potato土豆 carrot胡萝卜 onion洋葱 green beans四季豆
Are these/those...? 这些/那些是...吗？— Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
How many + 复数名词 + do you have?

mistakes.correct: sheep单复数一样：one sheep, many sheep

cards.memory_tip: 🐑 sheep像绵羊群一样，不管几只都长一样 → 单复数同形！和fish鱼一样
